text: Enter Demo opens the dashboard without a password.
The header identifies the active demo customer.
Logging out returns to the landing page; protected routes are not usable without a session.
The dashboard shows checking and savings accounts with readable names.
Balances are displayed to two decimal places in USD.
The UI must not expose a full account identifier (masked number only).
A valid transfer atomically updates source and destination balances.
Same-account transfers are rejected with a clear explanation and must not alter balances.
Zero, negative, and over-precision amounts are rejected without changing balances.
Transfers exceeding available balance are rejected; balances remain unchanged.
Successful transfers show a success state only after commit; failures must not show success.
Combined transaction history is viewable with date, type, amount, and status.
Applied filters must match every displayed row.
An empty filter result shows a clear empty state, not an error.
Profile shows synthetic display name and masked email only.
Interactive controls communicate validation and failure states clearly.
Submitted actions show loading or prevent duplicate submission while in flight.
